summary: This companion verification preprint presents an independent, zero-floating-point computational and formal-algebraic audit of the key 4096-dimensional Choi matrix construction in Faisal (arXiv:2611.34921v1) on C^8 x C^8. Using exact rational pivoted LDL^T factorizations across all 15 symmetry-orbit blocks (sizes 1, 3, 6, 22, 42) alongside an exhaustive 4096 x 64 integer kernel check, the manuscript establishes strict positive definiteness (rank 4096) for J+Q and Q^{Gamma_in} and exact rank 4032 with ker(J-Q) = im(|u> x I) for J-Q. It additionally reports 18 constructive Lean 4.35.0 theorems (no Mathlib, no sorry, no Classical.choice) capturing scalar algebraic and combinatorial pillars of Lemmas 1-6 and Corollary 2, plus 16 JSON certificates and worked witnesses. All visible formulas, traces, eigenvalues, and witness arithmetic verify consistently, with only minor presentational gaps regarding the scalar scope of the Lean statements, the diagonal-torus origin of the 15 blocks, and compressed notation in Tables 2-3.
weaknesses: The 18 Lean 4 theorems formalize scalar Z/N algebraic identities and inequalities (e.g., #7 for integers P, M >= 0 rather than PSD tensor powers (P+M)^{x n} -+ (P-M)^{x n} >= 0, #18 as a trivial inequality from assumed positivity) rather than the matrix Loewner-order or 4096-dimensional Choi certifications themselves, which reside in the external Python verifier.

Table 3 displays rounded decimal approximations (e.g., ~2172.42) for minimum positive LDL^T pivots of blocks B6, B22, and B42 instead of exact rational fractions, and full matrix entries of the 15 blocks are external to the PDF.

As a companion verification artifact, scientific impact is tied to the external correctness of the unverified functional-calculus and n-copy separable-operation arguments in the unrefereed target preprint [3].
